cases.question: Explain acknowledgments, retransmission and their limitations.
answers: TCP acknowledges received bytes and retransmits data after loss. A sequence number lets the receiver identify duplicate data. This provides reliable ordered delivery, but retransmission can increase latency. I would compare transfer completion and delay under a controlled packet loss test.

assessmentContext.text: TCP uses sequence numbers, acknowledgments and retransmission to provide reliable ordered delivery. Loss recovery can increase delay.
